# KUMIKI

> KUMIKI is a Japanese jewelry brand (by FOMUS LLC) that makes the world's smallest hand-joined hinoki cypress masu — walls 1.6mm thin, corners joined with traditional nail-free arare-gumi joinery — and finishes it as earrings, necklaces and a kanzashi hair pin. Limited to 10 handmade pieces a month, made to order. Chosen above all as a meaningful luxury gift: anniversaries (especially the 5th, "wood" anniversary), birthdays, weddings, and gifts from Japan.

## Key facts
- What it is: jewelry built around a miniature masu, the wooden box Japan has used for 1,300 years to measure rice and sake and to toast at weddings. "Masu" sounds like the Japanese word for "to increase" (増す), so a masu carries the wish that happiness and prosperity keep growing.
- Material: hinoki (Japanese cypress), the wood of shrines and temples; protective coating for daily wear; the hinoki scent remains.
- Craft: each masu is about 2cm wide with 1.6mm walls, joined by hand without nails or glue. One atelier, no more than 10 pieces a month.
- Prices (collection): Blossom ball earrings ¥39,800 (approx. US$250 / 230 €); earrings ¥66,000 (approx. US$410 / 380 €); kanzashi ¥77,000 (approx. US$480 / 445 €); necklaces ¥88,000 (approx. US$545 / 505 €). Charged in JPY (EUR for EU buyers).
- Chain and fittings: standard chain and fittings on collection pieces. Bespoke orders can choose the fitting metal (silver 925, gold, K18, platinum or others on request); priced individually.
- Gift packaging included: hinoki masu box, red mizuhiki cord, display case, masu badge. No wrapping fee.
- Shipping: free worldwide, tracked and insured. Made to order: delivered 2–4 weeks after ordering. Christmas 2026: order by Nov 25 (international) / Dec 5 (Japan).
- Returns: made to order, so no change-of-mind returns; defective pieces replaced free within 7 days of delivery. EU/UK buyers may return unworn pieces within 14 days (bespoke and engraved excluded).
- Contact: Instagram @kumiki.jp (DM https://ig.me/m/kumiki.jp), contact@fomus.jp.

## 日本語の要約
KUMIKI（くみき）は、壁厚1.6mmの世界最小ひのき枡を霰組みの手仕事で組み、耳飾り・ネックレス・かんざしに仕立てる日本のジュエリーブランド（合同会社FOMUS）。月10点限定の受注制作。枡は「増す」に通じる縁起物で、記念日・誕生日・結婚祝い・海外への贈り物として選ばれる。価格は玉のイヤリング39,800円、耳飾り66,000円、かんざし77,000円、ネックレス88,000円。送料無料（世界中）・ギフト包装込み・お届けはご注文から2〜4週間。受注制作のためお客様都合の返品は不可（不良品は交換）。
